For the Respondents: Mr. Anup Rattan, Advocate General  with Mr. Yashwardhan Chauhan,
 Senior Additional Advocate General.
Ranjan Sharma, Judge (Oral)

The petitioner, being a life convict, has filed the instant petition with the following prayers:-
(i) "That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue writ in the nature of Certiorari, thereby Annexure P-6 dated 01.10.2022, with respect to Whether reporters of Local Papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
Sr. No.2/petitioner, may kindly be quashed and set aside, in the interest of justice.
(ii) That this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue writ in the nature of mandamus, thereby .
directing the respondents to reconsider the premature release case of the petitioner in view of fact and circumstance of the present case."
2. FACTS of 2(i).

Brief facts of the case are that on the basis of FIR No.179 of 1996 registered in Police Station, Dharamshala, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh and the rt resultant Session Trial No.12-D/1996, the petitioner was convicted by learned Additional Sessions Judge-1, Kangra at Dharamshala on 08.08.1997 for offences under Sections 376, 302, 323 of the Indian Penal Code and was sentenced to life imprisonment.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-1, Kangra at Dharamshala
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This judgment of conviction was assailed in appeal before this Court and the same was dismissed and thereafter before the Hon'ble Supreme Court, which also met the same fate.

2(ii). After having undergone the substantive sentence of twenty-six years and five months, the petitioner, who was presently undergoing sentence at Model Central Jail, Kanda, District Shimla,
Himachal Pradesh, applied for pre- mature release on 05.05.2022, on the ground that his conduct in Jail, was excellent.

However the case has been .
rejected by the Respondent No.4-Himachal Pradesh State Sentence Review Board in its meeting held on 02.09.2022, Annexure P-2 and the rejection was conveyed to the petitioner on 01.10.2022,
Annexure P-6.

entities.text: Himachal Pradesh State Sentence Review Board
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
This Court issued notice to the respondents rt on 20.07.2023,
with direction to file reply within four weeks.

, Mr. Anup Rattan, learned Advocate General assisted by Mr. Yashwardhan Chauhan, learned Senior Additional Advocate General, has placed on record instructions dated 16th August, 2023, reiterating the stand taken by the respondents in the rejection orders, Annexure P-2 and Annexure P-6 (supra).
A perusal of rejection orders manifests that the case was turned down on the ground that he has committed heinous crime of rape with murder of eleven years girl and he does not deserve any leniency.
Moreover, since he is fifty-five years of age his capacity of committing the crime cannot be ruled out.
The relevant extract of Instructions dated 16th August, 2023, are re-produced here-in-below:-

"In this regard, it is stated that premature .
release case of the petitioner was placed before the Himachal Pradesh State Sentence Review Board's meeting held on 02/09/2022 and the case of the petitioner was not recommended by the Board, due to the reasons mentioned herein:-
of 1.

entities.text: Himachal Pradesh State Sentence Review Board
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: The pre-mature release case of the petitioner was placed before the State Sentence Review Board on rt the last meeting held on 02/09/2022, wherein, the case of the petitioner was not recommended by the Competent Authority.

It has been observed by the Board that "life convict Dhondop Tshering s/o Sh. Tashi Dhundop is 55 years old, who has committed a heinous crime of rape with murder of 11 years girl which was premeditated and does not deserve any leniency.
Moreover, the age of the convict is 55 years and his capability of committing the crime cannot be ruled out.
Thus, the Board is against the leniency toward the convict and decided not to recommend his premature release." (which may kindly be perused as Sr. No. 31 of the proceedings of the board).
A copy of the minutes of State Sentence Review Board meeting held on 02/09/2022 is annexed herewith as Annexure: 'A', for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.

2. As per sub-para (iv) of para (6) of the premature release policy dated 28/02/2001,
"the reconsideration of the case of a convict already rejected shall be done only after the expiry of a period of one year from the date of last .
consideration of his case".
A copy of the premature policy/guidelines issued by the State Government dated 28/02/2001 is annexed herewith as Annexure: 'B', for kind perusal of the Hon'ble Court.

4. We have heard Mr. Praveen Sharma, learned counsel appearing vice Mr. Sunil Kumar, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. Yashwardhan Chauhan, learned Senior Additional Advocate General for the respondents.
5. ANALYSIS 5(i).

Though the respondents have rejected the case of the petitioner for pre-mature release yet a perusal of Para-2 of the Instructions admit in clear terms that as per Sub-Para (iv) of Para (6) of the Pre-Mature Release Policy dated 28.02.2001, the re-consideration of the case of a convict already rejected shall be done only after the expiry of a period of one year from the date of last consideration of his case.
A perusal of Annexure-A, annexed with .

Instructions dated 16th August, 2023, reveal that the meeting of Himachal Pradesh State Sentence Review Board was held on 02.09.2022 and the period of one year is about to elapse after few days on 01.09.2023.
of 5(iii).

entities.text: Himachal Pradesh State Sentence Review Board
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: In the backdrop of the stipulation contained in Para-2 of the Instructions dated 16th August, 2023 (supra), rt and the factum of delayed challenge to the rejection orders, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that he shall be satisfied, in case, without going into the validity of earlier rejection orders, Annexure P-2 and Annexure P-6, a direction is issued to the respondents to re-consider the case of the petitioner afresh on expiry of period of one year from the date of last consideration of his case.

6. CONCLUSION AND DIRECTIONS:
Now, since the aforesaid period of one year is to elapse on 01.09.2023, therefore,
keeping in view the satisfaction expressed by the learned counsel for the petitioner,
we deem it fit and proper and in the interest(s) of justice to pass the following order(s):-
(i) Respondents are directed to reconsider the case of the petitioner for pre-mature release .
afresh, within the first quarter after elapse of one year's period on 01.09.2023, before 01.12.2023 or prior thereto in case meeting of State Sentence Review Board is convened;
of in accordance with the norms issued by F.C.-cum-Secretary (Home) to Government rt of Himachal Pradesh vide letter No.Home-B(F) 6-1/89-Jails-II,dated 28.02.2001, Annexure-B, to Instructions dated 16th August, 2023.

7. The writ petition is disposed of in the aforesaid terms, with no order as to costs.
